name: Wo Yun
source:
In a world where superpowers are common, you play as a private detective whose job is to solve cold cases. While investigating a serial killer, you saved three kids. Now you have to catch the killer while taking care of three kids.

[From [url=https://muricri.itch.io/graspluck]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一个超级大国普遍存在的世界里，你扮演一名私家侦探，其工作是解决悬案。在调查一名连环杀手时，你救了三个孩子。现在你必须一边抓捕凶手，一边照顾三个孩子。

[来自[url=https://muricri.itch.io/graspluck]Itch.io[/url]]
